name: AgilePlus
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Recent history adds handoffs, a REPL block-comment fix, v0.2.4 and cargo-dist build dependency/scoping changes. Pinned coverage workflow remains Python 85%, Rust 20%, Go report-only, with an echo-only aggregate claim.
concerns: Version bumps and precise CLI builds do not qualify desktop/MCP variants.
One owner chat now orchestrates all workstreams; a historical chat-split document is not a new allocation.
The workflow thresholds are configuration, not measured current code coverage.

next_actions.title: Repair the real assurance verdict
next_actions.work: Use separate supported-profile unit/integration/E2E reports, approved denominators, real artifact retrieval and explicit missing/below-floor failure. Reuse existing trusted coverage parsers rather than handrolling weak counters.
next_actions.acceptance: Injected missing, wrong-SHA and below-floor reports fail. Critical obligations are complete; accepted independent floors are actually enforced.

next_actions.title: Qualify current command and state behavior
next_actions.work: Exercise REPL comments, interrupted commands, two unrelated subject repositories, state persistence, MCP transitions and materialized views with exact engine receipts.
next_actions.acceptance: CLI/MCP operate on the intended Git root; restart and negative authorization cases pass without cross-subject state.

next_actions.title: Deliver the actual selected release
next_actions.work: Build/install the promised CLI and desktop profile outside the checkout; capture update/rollback and a useful work lifecycle.
next_actions.acceptance: Distributed artifact identity, clean install and actual end-to-end evidence; no unbuilt product surface certified by a CLI-only build.

ecosystem_contract: Use PhenoShared libraries and PhenoDocs rendering through explicit contracts. AgilePlus does not own portfolio-wide source data.
parent_acceptance: A cleanly installed tool manages a real subject through an accepted work lifecycle, with trustworthy independent evidence.
